en.summary: This commit fixes non-cacheable bypass response routing. The patch repacks NC request tags so requester ID, subline index, and UUID fields occupy the correct bit positions, and it updates memory muxes to skip the NC flag bit when selecting response-routing fields.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says it fixes an NC bypass bug.
The patch modifies cache and memory-routing RTL, not software or tests.
The changed tag slices and mux selector offsets directly determine which requester receives an NC response and which subword is extracted.
disqualifiers: The commit also includes naming cleanup that distinguishes tag ID bits from full tag width.
Several surrounding edits are mechanical renames, but the NC tag packing and routing changes are clearly behavioral.
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_nc_bypass.sv introduces CORE_TAG_ID_BITS and MEM_TAG_ID_BITS and repacks mem_req_tag_out so UUID bits stay separate from the requester/index fields.
The same module changes rsp_idx and rsp_addr_idx extraction to use CORE_TAG_ID_BITS-based offsets instead of CORE_TAG_IN_WIDTH-based offsets.
hw/rtl/VX_mem_unit.sv and hw/rtl/VX_cluster.sv add TAG_SEL_IDX(1) to memory muxes with comments saying they skip the NC flag bit.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A non-cacheable bypass path often needs to build a synthetic memory tag that combines requester identity, subline index, and original core tag information, sometimes alongside a mode bit that marks the request as non-cacheable. If the bit layout is wrong, or if response routing still slices fields as though the mode bit were absent, returned data are delivered to the wrong requester or extracted from the wrong subword position.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: NC bypass tag packing and response demultiplexing
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A non-cacheable request bypasses the normal cache path, especially when multiple requesters exist or when one external memory beat contains several smaller core words.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Pack the NC marker, requester index, subline index, and core tag fields with the wrong offsets so response routing interprets the wrong bits as requester or word-select fields.
portability_notes: Apply this to any bypass or uncached path that constructs synthetic tags rather than forwarding the original tag unchanged.
If the target DUT has no dedicated NC flag bit, use any similar inserted marker or metadata bit that shifts the tag layout.
The portable failure is misrouting by tag-field misalignment, not the specific macro names used in Vortex.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the uncached or bypass path that repacks tags before sending requests to memory.
Reintroduce the old field layout so requester index and subline index are computed from the full pre-fix tag width rather than the tag-ID width that excludes marker bits.
At the response side, slice the requester/index fields from the wrong bit positions, or remove the offset that skips the inserted NC marker bit.
Exercise multiple NC requesters or subline-split NC accesses so misrouting becomes visible.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: NC bypass tag construction and response field extraction
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix separates UUID bits from tag ID bits in VX_nc_bypass.sv, repacks mem_req_tag_out accordingly, and changes upstream memory muxes to skip the NC flag bit when selecting tag fields.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_nc_bypass.sv, rsp_idx and rsp_addr_idx now use CORE_TAG_ID_BITS-based offsets, and mem_req_tag_out is rebuilt from mem_req_tag_id_out plus optional UUID bits. In VX_mem_unit.sv and VX_cluster.sv, TAG_SEL_IDX(1) was added with comments that it skips the NC flag.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Non-cacheable memory responses can be delivered to the wrong requester, reconstructed with the wrong UUID or core tag, or extracted from the wrong subword within a wider memory beat.
evidence_for_injection: The fix distinguishes full incoming tag width from tag-ID width specifically to exclude marker bits from response-routing calculations.
Both the bypass module and the surrounding memory muxes had to change, which shows the bug was a real cross-module tag-layout mismatch.
The commit subject directly labels the issue as an NC bypass bug.
notes: VX_nc_bypass.sv is the primary injection site; changing mux selector offsets is a secondary reinforcement of the same bug.
This is a very portable tag-layout fault for any uncached or bypass memory path.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 non-cacheable bypass 的响应路由错误。补丁重新打包 NC 请求 tag，使 requester ID、subline index 和 UUID 字段位于正确的 bit 位置，并更新 memory mux 以在选择响应路由字段时跳过 NC flag 位。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确写明是 NC bypass bug。
补丁修改的是 cache 和 memory-routing RTL，而不是软件或测试。
被修改的 tag 切片和 mux 选择偏移直接决定 NC 响应会返回给哪个 requester，以及从宽内存拍中提取哪个子字。
disqualifiers: 该提交也包含一些把 tag ID bits 与完整 tag width 区分开的命名清理。
周边有若干机械性重命名，但 NC tag 打包与路由变化本身显然是行为修改。
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_nc_bypass.sv 引入了 CORE_TAG_ID_BITS 和 MEM_TAG_ID_BITS，并重新打包 mem_req_tag_out，使 UUID 位与 requester/index 字段分离。
同一模块把 rsp_idx 和 rsp_addr_idx 的提取位置从基于 CORE_TAG_IN_WIDTH 改成了基于 CORE_TAG_ID_BITS。
hw/rtl/VX_mem_unit.sv 和 hw/rtl/VX_cluster.sv 给 memory mux 增加了 TAG_SEL_IDX(1)，并带有“跳过 NC flag 位”的注释。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: non-cacheable bypass 路径通常需要构造一个合成内存 tag，把 requester 身份、subline index 和原始 core tag 信息拼在一起，有时旁边还会插入一个表示“该请求为 NC”的模式位。如果 bit 布局错了，或者响应路由仍然按“没有模式位”的旧布局去切字段，那么返回数据就会被送到错误 requester，或者从宽内存拍中取错子字位置。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: NC bypass 的 tag 打包与响应分发
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: non-cacheable 请求绕过正常 cache 路径，特别是在存在多个 requester，或一个外部内存拍包含多个较小 core word 时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 用错误偏移打包 NC 标志、requester 索引、subline 索引和 core tag 字段，使响应路由把错误 bit 当成 requester 或 word-select 字段。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 错误的 tag 位切片
portability_notes: 适用于任何需要重新打包 tag 的 bypass 或 uncached 路径，而不是简单透传原始 tag 的设计。
如果目标 DUT 没有专门的 NC flag 位，也可以选择任何会改变 tag 布局的插入式标记位或元数据位。
可移植的失效机制是“tag 字段失配导致的路由错误”，而不是 Vortex 中具体的宏名。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在发往内存前会重新打包 tag 的 uncached 或 bypass 路径。
恢复旧的字段布局，使 requester index 和 subline index 继续基于包含标记位的完整 tag 宽度来计算，而不是基于排除了标记位的 tag-ID 宽度。
在响应侧，从错误的 bit 位置切出 requester/index 字段，或者去掉跳过 NC marker 位的偏移。
使用多个 NC requester 或存在 subline split 的 NC 访问来暴露错误路由。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: NC bypass 的 tag 构造与响应字段提取逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 VX_nc_bypass.sv 中把 UUID 位与 tag ID 位分开处理，据此重新打包 mem_req_tag_out，并让上游 memory mux 在选择 tag 字段时跳过 NC flag 位。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_nc_bypass.sv 中，rsp_idx 和 rsp_addr_idx 改成基于 CORE_TAG_ID_BITS 的偏移，mem_req_tag_out 也改为由 mem_req_tag_id_out 加上可选 UUID 位构成。在 VX_mem_unit.sv 和 VX_cluster.sv 中，新增了 TAG_SEL_IDX(1) 并注明用于跳过 NC flag。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: non-cacheable 内存响应可能返回给错误 requester，带着错误 UUID 或 core tag 重建，或从宽内存拍中抽取了错误的子字。
evidence_for_injection: 修复明确把“完整输入 tag 宽度”和“排除 marker 位后的 tag-ID 宽度”区分开来，以便从响应路由计算中排除标记位。
bypass 模块和周围 memory mux 都必须同步修改，说明该 bug 是真实的跨模块 tag 布局失配。
提交标题直接把问题标记为 NC bypass bug。
notes: VX_nc_bypass.sv 是主回注点；修改 mux 选择偏移则是对同一 bug 的次级强化。
对于任何 uncached 或 bypass 内存路径，这都是一个高度可移植的 tag 布局故障。
